scripts.format: prettier --check --ignore-path=.prettierignore package.json eslint.config.mjs packages/eslint-config-custom/package.json packages/eslint-config-custom/flat.mjs apps/chef-battle/src apps/chef-battle/.eslintrc.cjs apps/chef-battle/tsconfig.json apps/chef-battle/tsconfig.quality.json
scripts.format:write: prettier --write --ignore-path=.prettierignore package.json eslint.config.mjs packages/eslint-config-custom/package.json packages/eslint-config-custom/flat.mjs apps/chef-battle/src apps/chef-battle/.eslintrc.cjs apps/chef-battle/tsconfig.json apps/chef-battle/tsconfig.quality.json
